title: New features and improvements in Copilot for JetBrains
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Copilot for JetBrains 1.18.0 adds assisted tool approvals, earlier-message re-editing with rewind, organization skills/instructions, Codex agent plan mode, and persistent MCP tool controls.
actionable_takeaway: Treat IDE agent sessions as governed workflows: record assisted approval policy, rewind scope, shared instruction source, plan approval, and MCP tool switches.

title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna now available
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: GitHub Copilot added GPT-6 Sol for balanced interactive/agentic coding and GPT-6 Luna for fast, cost-efficient assistance, joining GPT-6 Astra in the model picker.
actionable_takeaway: Build a three-lane model router: Astra for highest-stakes reasoning, Sol for everyday agentic coding, Luna for quick low-risk execution.

title: Claude Opus 5.5 is now available in GitHub Copilot
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Claude Opus 5.5 is available across Copilot surfaces for Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise users, with usage-based billing, admin policy controls, and text watermarking.
actionable_takeaway: When piloting Opus 5.5, record plan eligibility, admin enablement, provider pricing, watermark expectations, and long-task recovery evidence.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.156.0 stable
author: OpenAI / GitHub Releases
why_it_matters: Codex 0.156.0 makes fullscreen TUI, voice conversations, usage analytics, worktree command-center creation, daemon update controls, Mermaid/math rendering, and sandbox hardening part of the stable line.
actionable_takeaway: Promote 0.156.0 as the new stable evaluation anchor, but smoke TUI, voice, worktree, usage, daemon, and sandbox behavior before default rollout.

title: Copilot CLI 1.0.88 stable
author: GitHub Copilot CLI Releases
why_it_matters: Copilot CLI 1.0.88 stabilizes exact missing-path grants, network-denial bypass guidance, active-turn forking, namespaced skills, indexed search filtering, managed policy propagation, and safer session dismissal semantics.
actionable_takeaway: Update CLI receipts to separate exact path grants, network denial, fork lineage, namespaced skill loading, indexed search scope, and local-versus-server session deletion.

title: Copilot CLI 1.0.89-0 prerelease
author: GitHub Copilot CLI Releases
why_it_matters: Copilot CLI 1.0.89-0 adds Claude Opus 5.5 support and shows managed Connector consent progress with a copyable authorization URL during connect and reconnect.
actionable_takeaway: For connector-enabled agent work, save the consent state and reconnect URL as local evidence, but do not publish private auth URLs.

title: OpenAI Node 7.22.0 and 7.21.0
author: OpenAI SDKs
why_it_matters: OpenAI Node added session environment reset events, response management documentation, model-choice preservation fixes, and GPT-6 Sol/Luna model identifiers across two 2026-09-22 releases.
actionable_takeaway: Add session-reset and model-choice preservation checks to Node SDK smoke tests, and sync model identifier allowlists across app and agent layers.

title: OpenAI Python 3.19.0 / 3.18.0 / 3.17.0
author: OpenAI SDKs
why_it_matters: OpenAI Python 3.17.0 to 3.19.0 add external storage management, safety/webhook/session reset surfaces, GPT-6 Sol/Luna identifiers, GCP external storage, GPT-Rosalind, and safer replayable request retries.
actionable_takeaway: Bundle Python SDK upgrades with storage provider, safety event, session reset, model-id, and retry-replay contract tests.

title: Faster C++ code intelligence with whole codebase indexing
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: GitHub Copilot CLI now supports whole codebase indexing for C++ through the Microsoft C++ Language Server, with reusable symbol indexes, default enablement, /lsp logs progress checks, and memory/setup tradeoffs.
actionable_takeaway: For large C++ repos, treat first-run indexing as a scheduled warmup and capture /lsp logs before judging agent latency.

title: Security improvements for SSH
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: GitHub announced SSH security changes: removing several older algorithms, adding a newer algorithm, and requiring larger RSA SSH keys.
actionable_takeaway: Create an SSH compatibility inventory for CI, deploy keys, automation users, and local developer machines before enforcement dates surprise release workflows.

title: Deprecation notice: All-platform CodeQL bundle
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Starting with CodeQL CLI 2.27.0 the all-platform CodeQL bundle is deprecated, with removal planned for mid-March 2027; platform-specific downloads become the required path, especially for Linux ARM64.
actionable_takeaway: Pin CodeQL bundle downloads by OS/architecture now, and remove scripts that assume one all-platform artifact will exist forever.

title: Claude Code 2.1.280
author: Anthropic / GitHub Releases
why_it_matters: Claude Code 2.1.280 adds Opus 5.5 as default Opus, MCP description cap controls, hook telemetry sizing, symlink write landing checks, auto-mode denial backoff, dialog safety fixes, and dictation/model-switch reliability fixes.
actionable_takeaway: Use it as a comparison checklist for agent safety: symlink landing, repeated denial backoff, hook output sizing, and MCP description budgets should exist in every serious CLI agent.
